title: Skyrocket POC Evidence
overview:
This is the marketing homepage for **Skyrocket**, a fictional product-launch platform. It introduces the product to a visitor, communicates its value proposition, and gives them a way to get started, explore pricing, or get in touch.

The requirements below trace each of those visitor-facing claims to the tests that prove them.

hero.title: The hero section
hero.body:
The hero section is the first thing a visitor sees when they land on the page. It introduces **Skyrocket** by name, states the core promise in one sentence, and gives the visitor an immediate next step.

The **Get started free** button is the primary call to action — it should always be visible without scrolling and should link straight into the signup flow.

navigation.title: Site navigation
navigation.body: The top navigation bar lets a visitor jump to any major section of the page — **Features**, **Pricing**, and beyond — without needing to scroll to find it.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.body: Pricing information should be reachable from the main navigation, so a visitor can find cost details before they commit to signing up.

contact.title: Getting in touch
contact.body: The footer includes a direct **contact email** so a visitor with questions can reach the team without hunting for a contact form.

FR-TITLE-1.description: The homepage title identifies the product as Skyrocket.

FR-HERO-1.description: The hero section communicates the "launch faster" value proposition.

FR-CTA-1.description: The primary call-to-action links visitors to the get-started section.

FR-NAV-1.description: Site navigation provides a way to reach the Features section.

FR-CONTACT-1.description: The footer contact email is present and correctly linked.

FR-PRICING-1.description: Pricing information is visible to visitors before signup.
